incident.operation: resolve CHILD_SHA^ through Git object commit REST endpoint
incident.exposed_message_summary: message described replacing/aligning Tornado Future behavior with asyncio.Future and callback scheduling

resolver_repair: For R4/R5 and later, resolve CHILD_SHA^ only inside a non-cognitive CI step: initialize an empty git repo, fetch the child object with depth 2, run git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD^, and emit only the parent SHA plus repository/child identity. Do not call either GitHub commit REST endpoint and do not emit git log/show/cat-file output.
claim_boundary: R3 earns zero prospective scientific credit. It remains a counted member of the fixed R3-R5 panel.
